mechanism: Alprazolam may potentiate CNS depression and increase risk of hypotension/syncope, while zoledronic acid carries risk of osteonecrosis and renal toxicity; additive effects on falls risk in elderly patients.
action: Monitor for increased sedation, dizziness, and falls risk; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; assess need for benzodiazepine dose reduction in elderly or renally impaired patients.
